I think here can be several solution. Ignore cookies creation that mentioned at org.jboss.netty.handler.codec.http.DefaultCookie#RESERVED_NAMES when we have redirection. Or didn't parse them at all at CookieDecoder.

Also why you throw exception in this case. I read http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2109.txt and didn't find any mention of restricted cookie name.
